method: All ten actual PNGs across batch27/28 independently viewed in groups of at most two. Complete manifests, current RAT/KOR/FOR space cards and screenplay scene setup/basis passages checked. Original 95/96 pixels not re-viewed; revisions assessed on their own pixels against stated targets and prior QA. No art, manifest, story or code changes.

limitations: Review concepts only; no native-grid, collision, engineering, animation, game or physical-safety validation.
Static objects never prove payments, rescue outcomes, consent, arrival, genealogy, authentic history or exact inventory.
No original reference images independently viewed in this pass; their byte hashes verified only.

findings.finding: Inert animal relief, two differently marked small tablets and one empty witness inset are clear. Street-level aid counter has its own approach independent of memorial steps, a closed pouch and limited shelving. Background grazing animals are ordinary livestock, not the dead legendary beast. No private family names are shown. The relief does not settle historical identity or testimony; tokens do not prove actual loss assessment or payment.

Detached damaged fence samples and one evidence bell are outside the shelter, reached through an open yard. Right room has an empty table and two chairs, closed folio and separate medallion; public talk window and open side passage avoid any depicted sleeping area. Tooth-like cuts are stylized and cannot establish species, cause or a new attack. Cutaway view of household objects is an art convention, not permission to read or enter. Extra hanging fixtures should not be counted as evidence bells.

Three hanging wooden rattles and side pull loop appear in daylight; sheep remain beyond the fence and no attack is depicted. Ground marks remain stylized; observation clearance and safe operation cannot be proven from art. Independent open mould workshop has two mould halves, metal sample, blank tag and closed pouch. The tag is NOT an actual replica disclosure: production must supply readable localized replica labeling before an authorized sale. Neither sample nor closed pouch proves licensing or a completed refund; false sound never cancels current ordinary animal risk.

One modest bell rests on a cradle with detached shaft/bushing and separate pendant. The assistance counter opens directly to the level public lane, independent of repair or ritual. Its two token trays differ in OUTER shapes (round versus triangular) as well as apparent holes; the specified round-hole versus triangular-hole code needs clear final sprites rather than relying solely on outer silhouette. Static repair props do not certify a safe bell, actual separate allocations or withdrawal of an attendance condition.

The right shelter side doorway is open and connects to a continuous stone/earth sloping surface and dry street, without the former short stair treatment described in batch25 QA. Stretcher, mine shelter and safety rail remain present at left; no rescued person or payment is depicted. Prefer v2 for the targeted ramp concept. Actual slope, landing size, stretcher turning radius, guardrail and collision remain unverified. Original pixels were not independently re-viewed in this pass, so no pixel-exact preservation claim is made.

overall: RAT independent aid, private family contact and old-beast separation supported. 95 v2 ramp target passes concept review. Replica labeling and aid-token hole coding remain production details.
